title: 开会和沟通的功能表达
summary: 同意、不同意、打断、总结、争取时间

markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 开会时最难的不是词汇，是「怎么开口」。这里按用途分好了现成的句子：同意、反对、插话、听不懂……先挑每组一两句背熟，开会时直接用。

items.en: Shall we [[get started]]?
items.rule: 人到得差不多了，主持人开场

items.en: [[Let's wait a couple of minutes]] for the others to join.
items.zh: 等几分钟，其他人还在进来。

items.en: [[Can everyone hear me]] OK?
items.zh: 大家都能听到我说话吗？

items.en: [[Thanks for joining]], everyone.
[[The aim of today's meeting is]] to agree on the release date.
items.zh: 今天开会的目的是定下发版日期。

items.en: [[We've got three things to cover]] today.
[[Let's start with]] the crash reports.
OK, [[let's move on to]] the next item.
[[I think]] we should ship it on Monday.
items.zh: 我觉得我们应该周一发版。

items.en: [[In my view]], the old API is easier to use.
items.zh: 在我看来，旧接口更好用。

items.en: [[I'd say]] it'll take about two days.
items.rule: 给估计、给判断，语气不那么绝对

items.en: [[From a technical point of view]], it's doable.
[[It seems to me that]] we're trying to do too much.
items.zh: 我感觉我们想做的太多了。

items.en: [[I'm fairly sure]] it's a caching issue.
items.zh: 我挺确定是缓存的问题。

items.en: [[My main concern is]] performance on older phones.
items.zh: 我最担心的是旧手机上的性能。

items.en: [[If you ask me]], we need more testing.
items.zh: 要我说，我们需要多测测。

items.en: [[I agree]].
[[That's a good point]].
[[That makes sense]].
[[Exactly]]. That's what I was thinking.
[[I'm with you on that]].
[[Sounds good to me]].
[[Fair enough]].
items.rule: 英式常用：本来有点不同意，但接受对方的理由

items.en: [[I couldn't agree more]].

commonMistakes.why: agree 是动词，前面不加 am。

disagree.title: 不同意（客气地）
disagree.text: 英国人很少直接说 You're wrong 或 I disagree。**先肯定一点，再说 but**；多用 not sure、a bit、maybe 把语气放软。

items.en: [[I see what you mean, but]] I'm not sure it'll scale.
items.zh: 我明白你的意思，但我不确定它扛得住量。

items.en: [[I take your point, but]] the deadline is very tight.
items.zh: 你说得有道理，但时间太紧了。

items.en: [[That's true, but]] we also need to think about the cost.
items.zh: 没错，但我们也得考虑成本。

items.en: [[I'm not sure I agree]].
[[I see it a bit differently]].
[[I'm not convinced]] it's worth the extra work.
items.zh: 我不太相信这值得多花这些功夫。

items.en: [[Have we considered]] using the system picker instead?
items.zh: 我们有没有考虑过改用系统的选择器？

items.en: [[Could we look at it another way]]?

commonMistakes.why: agree 后面跟人要加 with。

items.en: [[Sorry to interrupt, but]] can I add something?
items.zh: 抱歉打断一下，我能补充一点吗？

items.en: [[Can I just come in here]]?
[[If I could just add one thing]], the API is still in beta.
items.zh: 我补充一点，这个接口还在测试阶段。

items.en: [[Just a quick point]]: the tests are still failing.
items.zh: 简单说一句：测试还没过。

items.en: [[Before we move on]], can I ask about the budget?
items.zh: 在进入下一项之前，我能问下预算吗？

items.en: [[Going back to what Tom said]], I think he's right.
items.zh: 回到汤姆刚才说的，我觉得他是对的。

items.en: [[Sorry, go ahead]].
[[Sorry, can I just finish]]?
items.zh: 不好意思，我先说完好吗？
items.rule: 被人打断时，客气地拿回话头

clarify.title: 确认听懂、请对方重复
clarify.text: 听不懂一点都不丢人，**不懂装懂才麻烦**。用下面的句子，母语者每天也在说。

items.en: [[Sorry, I didn't catch that]].
[[Sorry, could you say that again]]?
[[Sorry, you broke up]] there. Could you repeat that?
items.zh: 抱歉，你刚才卡了，能再说一遍吗？

items.en: [[Could you speak a bit more slowly]], please?
[[What do you mean by]] "later"?
items.zh: 你说的「晚一点」是指什么时候？

items.en: [[Just to check I've understood]], you want me to fix the login bug first?
items.zh: 我确认一下，你是想让我先修登录的 bug？

items.en: [[So what you're saying is]], we need to delay the release?
items.zh: 所以你的意思是，我们得推迟发版？

items.en: [[Could you give me an example]]?
[[Does that make sense]]?
items.rule: 自己讲完，确认别人听懂了

time.title: 争取时间
time.text: 被突然问住时，先说一句这样的话，脑子就有几秒钟可以想。**比沉默或者 em… em… 好得多。**

items.en: [[That's a good question]].
[[Let me think about that for a second]].
[[How can I put it]]?
[[Let me just check]] my notes.
Well, [[it depends]] on the budget.
[[What I'm trying to say is]], we need more time.
items.zh: 我想说的是，我们需要更多时间。

items.en: [[I'm not sure off the top of my head]].
[[Can I get back to you on that]]?
items.zh: 这个我回头答复你可以吗？

items.en: [[So, to sum up]], we're moving the release to Friday.
items.zh: 总结一下，发版挪到周五。

items.en: [[Let me just recap]] what we've agreed.
items.zh: 我把我们定下的事回顾一下。

items.en: [[The next step is]] to test it on real devices.
items.zh: 下一步是在真机上测试。

items.en: [[Who's going to]] take care of the release notes?
[[I'll take that one]].
[[Let's aim to]] finish it by Thursday.
[[Can you send round]] the notes after the meeting?
items.zh: 会后你能把纪要发给大家吗？
items.rule: 英式：send round 发给所有人

items.en: [[Let's park that for now]].
items.rule: 话题跑偏或一时谈不完

items.en: [[Let's take this offline]].
items.rule: 只和少数人有关的话题

items.en: [[Is there anything else]] before we finish?
[[I think that's everything]].
[[Let's wrap up here]].
[[Thanks, everyone]]. That was really helpful.
[[Same time next week]]?
[[I'll let you get back to work]].
items.rule: 一对一聊完，客气地结束

items.en: [[Have a good weekend]], everyone.
[[Speak soon]].
